subject: Comfy restored; bounded Cantina identity proof still in preflight
body:
Ziggy asked CFA Nova to route concerns to you while he chats with you. Direct chat delivery failed again with the AbsolutePathBuf/base-path startup error. This is a local mailbox fallback; no chat delivery, reading or wakeup is established.

Current authorized work: finish one bounded Harrison Ford identity proof in the accepted Multiverse Hon Dolo Cantina toast source. Ziggy reports that Comfy has been refilled. CFA Nova now observes Cloud Run enabled and the out-of-credits alert absent. No generation has run.

Remaining preflight: verify source-frame alignment and the canonical post-trim route; check face masks and preservation of tattoos, grill, jewelry, hand/glass contact and source audio. The raw-decode wire is not established as a frame-offset defect. Paid video generation remains limited to one run, batch one, with no automatic retries.

No user decision is requested now. CFA Nova continues these checks and will surface a concrete blocker if one remains. Lisan Al Gaib is separate and was never intended to receive an external actor face transfer.

Prepared test records: docs/notes/explorable_world/comfy/projects/hon_dolo_strictly_business/comfy/cantina_toast_identity_20261012/. This status relays the active CFA coordinator report; it does not claim an independently executed test or accepted result.

source.description: User-authorized concern relay from the active CFA Codex Nova task; direct chat send failed.
